whatsNew.en-AU:
TaskNotes now speaks ten languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. It follows your device language, or you can choose one in Settings.

The calendar has been rebuilt, with a new Year view, a date strip in Upcoming on phones, and a clear choice between one occurrence and the whole series when you move or edit a repeating task.

This update also shows overdue work on Today, adds smoother transitions, makes Back close an open task, and fixes dates for timed and all-day tasks in time zones west of UTC.

reviewNotes:
TaskNotes 1.0.10 update

HOW TO REVIEW
TaskNotes needs an mdbase account. We have provided a review account in the App Review sign-in information. Its sample collection already contains tasks.
1. Open TaskNotes and start the mdbase sign-in flow.
2. An mdbase sign-in page opens in a browser sheet. Sign in with the review account, choose the collection "[test] C hosted tasks", and approve TaskNotes.
3. You return to TaskNotes with that collection open.

WHAT CHANGED
- The interface is translated into ten languages. It follows the device language and can be changed in Settings.
- The calendar has been rebuilt and adds a Year view and a date strip in Upcoming on phones.
- Moving or editing a repeating task in the calendar asks whether the change applies to one occurrence or the series.
- Smoother transitions and several date fixes.
There are no new permissions, no new data collection and no in-app purchases. Screenshots are still representative.

WHAT THE APP DOES
TaskNotes is a task manager that stores tasks as portable Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, assign and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, repeats, reminders and time estimates; use lists, boards and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

SERVICES USED
mdbase stores the user's collection and schedules reminders. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver reminder notifications only after the user opts in. The notifications carry no task content.
